Accroches écrites : « how to be the guest everyone wants to invite back » (retenue : savoir-vivre élégant, concret, très enregistrable), « dinner party rules nobody teaches you » (écartée : plus proche des « rules » vagues à éviter), « the art of being a good guest » (écartée : moins de promesse). slides.texte_overlay:
how to be the guest
everyone wants to invite back

1. arrive 5 to 10 minutes
after the time, never before

the host is still getting ready.

2. bring flowers already
in a vase

no one has to stop and look
for one.

3. offer to help once.
if they say no, let it go.

4. bring one good story

a painting, a strange fact,
a moment from history.
it carries a whole dinner.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. bring one good story

i find mine in 5 minutes a day
on a micro-learning app like
the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. ask about one object
in their home

a photo, a book, a lamp.
there's always a story.

6. leave while everyone
is still laughing

7. send a thank-you message
the next morning

name one thing you loved.

save this before your
next dinner
